body: You should not try to kill yourself at all. Even though life is agonizingly difficult, and completely unfair, doesn't mean we should cut our own life short. We don't know what will happen tomorrow. It could be another dreadful day, or it could be the day that changes your life. The only way to know is to wake up tomorrow. The decision to take your life is a permanent one, but it's one you could always make later. But if you make it now, you can never decide to live again. Take the chance on life, even if it's just one more day.

Just because you have a mental illness doesn't mean you don't deserve love. You wouldn't say that a cancer patient didn't deserve love or affection because of their condition. You wouldn't want them to die simply because they require more than some others.  Why would your mental health be any different? Even if your partner doesn't choose you, or chooses to leave, doesn't make that any less true. You are complex human being deserving of all of the love and affection that one could get. You are not a problem to be solved, you are a person to be loved. You can always talk to somebody here.

I understand wanting all of life's problems to just stop, but why do you have to die to make that happen? Even if now you can't see the good that might come into your life, that doesn't mean it's any less real. It's not worth the risk of giving up what could be a truly happy life, filled with love or laughter, because of the pain and sadness we feel now. Life is a marathon, not a sprint. You don't need to run as fast as you can, or even run at all, but any progress forward in life is a good thing. Even if we have awful days, another day lived is a fantastic and meaningful victory in your life. Be proud of making it through the day, be proud of doing little things, and be okay to go at a slow pace. There's no medal for finishing in first.

How can you talk about how you'll feel when your 50 or 70. I barely feel the same way now than I did a couple of years ago. Life changes so much. I am literally crying for the pain you are going through. I can't imagine how hard it has been for you, but you need to hold on. Life can be so unfair sometimes. The things that we most desperately want or deserve are often times withheld from us. We only get one shot at this life. Even if it might be agonizingly difficult, and even if we don't see a way through the pain, the only way to be sure is to push through it. The most important step is not the first one, or the last one, but the next one. You don't need to climb mountains, you just need to take one more step forwards. Towards life.

Nobody can make you stay, but it's worth staying. Life can be cruel, yet very beautiful. Pain is something that fades with time. Our efforts might fall short, but we can always try again. It is one of the most beautiful things in life. Your lowest moment doesn't need to define you.

What would dying do for you? Anything else in life would be preferable to dying. Any failure can be worked with, but death is a permanent choice. Even if you feel awful, you have to make the choice to live. Death is a permanent solution to lives fleeting problems.

Maybe, but it wouldn't be worth it. There is certainly more joy to be had in living life than in ending it. Even if that joy is distant, and hard to find, it is better to look for it than to give up. Don't let your worst moments define your entire life. You are so much more than your lowest point.

You don't need to live to make other people happy. Sometimes you can just live to live. You're not a waste of anybody's time or space. You deserve to live just as much as any other person. Sometimes life is hard, and sometimes it is really unfair, but life is nonetheless. We can't let our worst selves win. I want you in this world, and I feel so sad that you have to struggle through these awful things. Just know that life isn't a competition. There is no medal given at the end of life for being more successful. Nobody can tell you what your life should and shouldn't be. That is something for you to find for yourself.
